correctness.rationale: For each m>=1 the two rank variables are exactly negative-prefix and positive-suffix occupation sums. Independent symmetric sign blocks satisfy pair-product sum identity 1 by conditioning on magnitudes. All ordered compositions of m yield covariance -(m+1)(m+2)/24, while the two-block sign identity gives both variances m(m+1)/8. Every boundary, including m=1 and zero-length outer blocks, is accounted for. The embedded checker independently passes 36 exact rational moment identities and 92 sign examples; finite tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: The two natural endpoint ranks have equal arcsine marginals, but their joint negative dependence is not inferable from separate marginals. The exact all-size cross-covariance and sharp universal correlation limit -1/3 are a meaningful boundary-statistic law, with an independent structural three-block sign identity and no moment assumptions. It informs ordinal analysis of nonstationary sample paths, without asserting a broader inference theorem.
